summary: A focus-trapping dialog. Renders nothing when closed and portals when open.
useWhen: the task must be completed or abandoned before anything else
a short focused form that would otherwise need its own page

useInstead.when: the content is supplementary and the page stays usable
useInstead.why: a Popover does not trap focus or block the page

useInstead.when: it is a short label for a control

fullscreen.use: immersive tasks; fills the viewport and pins the actions to the bottom edge

left.use: the default; forms and anything the user reads

footer.note: the primary action goes last, at the trailing edge

guarantees: focus moves into the panel on open and returns to the trigger on close
Escape and a scrim click both close it
nothing is rendered at all while closed, so no closed-modal content is keyboard reachable
requires: `title`, which provides the dialog's accessible name

antiPatterns.dont: rendering <Modal> only when a state flag is true
antiPatterns.why: Modal already renders nothing when closed. Wrapping it in a conditional discards the open/close transition and the focus-return behaviour.

antiPatterns.dont: opening a Modal from inside another Modal
antiPatterns.why: two focus traps compete and Escape becomes ambiguous

antiPatterns.dont: a destructive action as the only button, with no cancel
antiPatterns.why: a confirmation with no way out is not a confirmation
